provenance.prompt:
Create a transparent-background pixel-art atlas with exactly TWO side-by-side square cells in this order: TOP, BOTTOM, for the single College of Magic entrance shown in the attached reference images. Use the native College entrance as the only identity/material authority: pale gray carved stone arch, central open doorway, one small stone wizard statue on each side, two blue banners, round blue-gold crest above, green vines. The current source-plus-six image supplies accepted elevations and exact target scale. The Iron Tracks open doorway TOP/BOTTOM are geometry-only examples for shallow doorway frame plans; do not copy their materials or omit College details.

Both cells are true orthographic plans. TOP camera is straight down +Z; BOTTOM camera straight up from below -Z. No frontal arch facade, no upright statues, no full-height columns visible as faces, no oblique perspective, no isometric angle, no corner view. Keep the same physical object orientation and shallow facade depth. The footprint is a narrow shallow rectangular stone entrance frame: broad X span across the two side statues and arch, short Y depth matching the accepted RIGHT/LEFT thickness, not a generic square tile or four-corner panel.

TOP: show the arch crown/crest and two side-statue head/shoulder caps as small top-facing shapes in their source positions, blue banner cloth only as thin edge strips, central open passage as a dark elongated opening, and shallow stone lintel/cap surfaces. Preserve the two statues and banner positions; do not replace them with four gems or extra posts.
BOTTOM: same complete narrow footprint viewed from below, pale stone footing/underside and the two statue/base foot undersides in matching positions, with central open passage underneath. No upright frontal arch, no generic square support panel, no invented corner ornaments. Draw one isolated plan silhouette per cell, centered at consistent scale, generous transparent margins, no shadows/labels/cell bleed. Match Pocket Dungeon pixel art and palette; unseen surfaces are conservative inferences.

reference_inputs.role: native target identity, accepted elevations and plan geometry; canonical source is authoritative

provenance.notes: Root-scoped-accepted College of Magic entrance plan; target facade identity and open passage preserved; pending whole-set review.
